identityTest.stableIdentity: A reusable assurance procedure remains identifiable across engagements, performers and individual executions while its approved method evolves through controlled revisions.
identityTest.versionIdentity: Changes to objective, prerequisites, steps, evidence requirements, sampling method or decision rule create immutable procedure versions; materially different assurance objectives create separate procedures.
identityTest.mastership: audit methodology or assurance procedure authority

owns: approval, versioning, supersession and retirement history

invariants: Reusable procedure definition and performed procedure execution never share identity.
Every performed procedure pins the exact approved procedure version used.
Changes to method, evidence requirements, sampling or decision rule create a new immutable version.
A procedure definition never owns engagement mandate, assurance level or issuance authority.
Criteria are pinned before findings based on the procedure are issued.
Population, sampling frame, frame gaps, selection method, sample units and deviations remain explicit in execution records.
Statistical confidence is never implied without a supporting method and denominator.
Observation, evidence acquisition, evidence appraisal and finding remain distinct.
Procedure completion never closes a finding, issue or corrective-action task.
Management response never counts as corrective action or independent retest.
Competence and independence requirements are declared separately and evidenced per engagement.
Retired and superseded procedure versions remain resolvable for issued work.
holds: Registry namespace and identifier allocation are pending and no identifier may be guessed.

WM-ACT-033 and WM-ECO-035 dual-root ownership must be normatively resolved before publication.
Criteria, evidence and sampling relation contracts require canonical reconciliation.
